mentions.name: Toolbit
mentions.description: Toolbit is a fully local Electron desktop app bundling 40+ developer utilities such as a regex tester, PDF merge, image conversion, cron builder, and JSON/JWT and base64 tools. It adds workspaces for grouping tools around a task, tool chaining to avoid copy/paste, snippets, history, recent items, and automatic detection that routes pasted data to the right tool. It runs offline with no accounts, no tracking, and no data sent out, aiming to reduce friction in everyday dev glue work instead of bouncing between dozens of web tools.
mentions.problem: Developers bounce between dozens of web tools for small glue-work tasks like JSON/JWT decoding, base64, regex testing, and cron expressions; Toolbit consolidates these into one local, privacy-friendly app to reduce friction.
mentions.audience: A local developer utility app aimed at reducing friction in everyday dev work.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been iterating on Toolbit (https://toolbit.app), a local developer utility app I initially shared a while back.
